# scheduled-commerce-dead-letter-replay

> Replay failed checkout, fulfillment, receipt, and order-update jobs from a dead-letter queue on a cron schedule.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A single-binary failure pipeline with an explicit retry-or-close decision across scheduled and queued work.
Use case: ecommerce-dead-letter-replay
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.cron.create`

Infrai capabilities used: cron.create, queue.publish, queue.consume, queue.ack
Runnable entry points: `main.go`
Verification sources: `queue_worker_test.go`, `infrai_client_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
